content: Chapanga abhabhone kiya bhando bhu ku Ichilahele
Ngohe nikonya bho, Chapanga abhakanite bhando bhake? Nahi jhe abhakanite jhe! Ne namwete ndi Mwichilahele, kibheluko cha Ulahimo, nihumii mu likabila lya Benjamine.

Chapanga abhakanite jhe bhando bhake bhabhahagwii kutumbulii makacho. Bho, umanye jhe chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga pala Eliya pannelila Chapanga kwa uhakaho gwa aka Ichilahele? Jwenio akalongii,
“Bhambo, akakomite milondole bhino na kutilulana njangwale ya matambiko hino. Na nenga ighilile kanjika ndo, na bhene bhapala kungoma.”
Bho, Chapanga akajhangite kilebhe ghane? Akannongolile, “Nikebhekii bhando elufo chaba bhibhakanite kutama makilikite palonge jha kinyagho Baale.”
Naha ndi chibhii ngohe, bhabhii bhando bhandina bhibhahaghulilwe kwa umbone gwa jhajhe gwa Chapanga.

Bhakahaghulilwe kwa ndela jhaumbone gwa jhajhe gwake Chapanga, chi kwa ghala ghubhatehila. Nhwalo ngita Chapanga ihaghuu kwa kulolekeya mahengo gha bhando umbone gwake gwa jhajhe ngaubhii kilebhe nacho.
Ngohe nike? Bhando bhu ku Ichilahele chela chibhapaliya bhakapatite jhe, nambo bhala bhibhakahaghulilwe na Chapanga bhakapatite. Na bhange bhakibha na lighoho.
Ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga, “Chapanga atehi miojho jhabhe kujhundupa, ade deleno jheno bhahoto jhe kulola kwa miho ghabhe, amu kujhoha kwa machikilo ghabhe.”

Miho ghabhe ghalekwii lubhendo ghahoto jhe kulola.

content: Bhahe, nikonya kabhele, bho, Akayahude bhakobhondwike ade kukomelekeya njwe? Na pandina jhe! Nambo kulemwa kwabhe ughombokeko gwajhendilile bhando bha ilambo yoha, na Akayahude bhakole wiho.

Ulemo gwa Akayahude gwaletii mota bhando bha nnema, na kupongokewa kwabhe kwa kihobholelo kwatehi bhando bha ilambo henge bhabha na mota. Bhahe, ndi chakaka kubhehe Akayahude bhoha anda bhang'alambukiye Chapanga mota naijhonjekeka hake.
Ughombokeko gwa bhando bha ilambo henge
Ngohe nilonge na mangota bhando bha ilambo henge, kwa nhwalo nenga natenga kwa bhando bha ilambo, niloke lihengo lyango.
Hote kwatenda bhando bhango Akayahude bhakole wiho, nihoto kwaghombola bhange pakate jhabhe.

Nhwalo anda kukanilwa kwabhe Akayahude kukajhambukii bhando bhoha bhabha bhajhelenichwe nde na Chapanga, nahibha bhole pala pubhajheketelwa na Chapanga? Naubhaha ughome kwa bhando bhubhakibha bhawile kihuke!

Anda kipande chukutumbuu cha libumunda likapihitwe palonge jha Chapanga, libumunda lyoha lipihitwe palonge jhake Chapanga. Anda mikegha jha nkongo ibhii jhaumbone, helahela mandabhe ghake ubhehe ghaumbone hele.

Nambo anda ghabhii mandabhe gha Micheitune gwambone gwa kupandwa uhekitwe, na mangota bhumii ncheitune gwa kumanyahe nnombine pamba. Na mangota bhando bha ilambo henge ndi nnandine na lindabhe lya ncheitune gwa kumanyahe, yenio ngohe ntumii likakala lya ncheitune gwambone gwa kupandwa.

Bhahe, nkotoka kwapuucha bhala Akaichilahele bhubhahekwite ngita mandabhe! Bho, ngohe nahotola bhole mangota mabhando bha ilambo henge kukiloka? Nkomboke kubhehe mangota ndi mandabhe tugha, mangota mikegha jhe, nambo mikegha ndi jhijhintangatila mangota.
Nambo mwenga nanongela, “Mandabhe ghala ghahekitwe twenga tulombonechwe chehemo jhake.”
Chakaka, gheniya chakaka. Ghahekitwe kwa nhwalo gwangakihobholelo, nambo mwenga nnyemite kwa nhwalo mijheketela. Ngohe, mwangalokela, nambo nnyoghope.
Nhwalo anda Chapanga akalekekii jhe Akayahude bhubhakibha anda mandabhe gha lihembuko, bho, pumihambuka Chapanga nanekekeya mangota?

Bhahe, dola umbone gwa Chapanga na lilaka lyake. Jwenio ulakala kwa bhala bhangajhokanikiya, na jwaumbone kwino mwenga anda nanyendelela kutama muumbone gwake, anda nahijhe, na mangota hele nauheketwa.
Na bhene Akayahude anda changatama changahobholela kwabhe, nabhapandikichwa kabhele chehemo jhene jhibhahekite. Nhwalo Chapanga abhii na ukindendeke gwa kwapandikicha kabhele.

Mangota bhando bha ilambo henge, milandana na mandabhe gha ncheitune gwa kumanyahe. Mukabhohitwe kwenio na kupandikichwa ku ncheitune gwa kung'onda chehemo jhabhe ndeka. Nambo Akayahude bhilandana na ncheitune gwa kung'onda. Nakibhaha kilebhe kijhojhoho kupandikichwa munkongo gwabhe bhene.
Chapanga abhabhone kiya bhando bhoha

Makalongo bhango, mbala jhe nkoto kumanya chile jhenje, pange mihoto kukiwacha nkwete malango hake, lighoho lya Akaichilahele likibha kwa kipinde chandina tugha, ade bhando twe bha ilambo yoha pubhapala kung'alambukila Chapanga.
Peniya ndi Akaichilahele bhoha nabhaghombolelwa, ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga,

content.text: nabhoa ghanganandela ghoha mukibheluko cha Yakobu.
Lende ndi lilaghano limbala kuhenga nabho

content: Nhwalo Akayahude bhalikana Lilobhe lya Mbone, bhayokite makoko bha Chapanga kwa kujhambulila kwino mangota bhando bha ilambo henge. Nambo nhwalo bhahaghulilwe na Chapanga, bhamela bhipalwa na Chapanga kwa nhwalo gwa akahoko bhabhe.
Bhahe, Chapanga aghambula jhe malango panane jha jwahagwii na jwampekii mota.
Makacho mangota mkanekite kunnyokanikiya Chapanga, nambo ngoheno mangota mpatite kiya jhake kwa kukana kwabhe Akayahude kunnyokanikiya Chapanga.
Helahela ngita mangota chimpokile kiya jha Chapanga, Akayahude bhikana kunnyokanikiya Chapanga, na bhahoto kupoke kiya jha Chapanga.
Nhwalo Chapanga abhatehi bhando bhoha bhakoto kunnyokanikiya kupala abhabhone kiya bhoha.
Tunnombe Chapanga

Ulohe gwa Chapanga chiubhii gwa kukangacha! Na malango ghake chighabhii makolongwa! Na kumanya kwake chukubhii kukolongwa. Bho, ghane jwahoto kumanya chahadabula? Bho, ghane jwahoto kuhumbuu ndela jhake?
Ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga,
Nhwalo ilebhe yoha ihuma kwa jwenio, ibhii kwa ukindendeke gwake na kwa nhwalo gwake. Ung'alicho ubhehe kwa jwenio Chapanga machiko ghoha ghangapeta! Amina.
